_comment: Which of mxm-fx-curve's parameters fill the collection's control roles.
Roles come from docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md and parameters use permanent string ids.
Mix fills fx.dynamics: how much of the serial memoryless/detector curve stack is in
